1\. The Master Invocation (The "Baphrenemoun" Formula)
------------------------------------------------------

Located within the rectangular containment boxes beneath the central entities (visible in telemetry logs 4, 5, and 8), this text is one of the most powerful known _voces magicae_ (words of power) from the Greco-Egyptian magical tradition.

\[TRANSCRIPTION - GREEK/COPTIC UNCIALS\]  
Ιαεω · βαφρενεμουν · οθιλαρικριφια · ευεαι · φιρκιρα · λιθονυομενερφαβωεα  
(Iaeo · Baphrenemoun · Othilarikriphia · Eueai · Phirkira · Lithonuomenerphaboea)  

### Translation & Algorithmic Meaning

*   **Ιαεω (Iaeo):** A Hellenized permutation of the Hebrew Tetragrammaton (Yahweh). It represents the supreme creator code.
*   **βαφρενεμουν (Baphrenemoun):** An Egyptian derivative phrase translating roughly to _"He whose name is hidden"_ or _"He who is upon the primeval waters/abyss."_
*   **The Vowel Strings (ευεαι):** These are not standard words. In Hermetic acoustics, the seven Greek vowels correspond to the seven planetary spheres. Chanting them in sequence was believed to align the practitioner's vocal frequencies with the cosmic engine.
